question: What do we do between the reporting time and the start of classes?
answer: You will be assigned a hostel, stay on campus, and have freshmen orientation sessions, and you can also explore the campus and meet other students. If you don't attend, there are no consequences, but you will miss out on important information and opportunities to make friends.

question: How long should parents stay after completing admission formalities?
answer: As long as they want to.

question: Are families allowed in the guest house?
answer: In general, yes, but during admission season, no.

question: Are mattresses provided with hostel?
answer: No, we recommend bringing your own or buying one from the campus store.

question: Do the freshers get single rooms?
answer: No, they have to share rooms with other students. But most get single rooms after the first year, depending on availability.

question: What should the freshers bring?
answer: Campus stores and nearby shops.

question: What are the dimensions of the hostel cots?
answer: There are different types of beds and you won't know until you've been assigned your room. But the campus vendors know the dimensions of the beds in every hostel and can help you buy a mattress that fits.

question: Am I allowed to have a motor vehicle on campus?
answer: No, students are not allowed to have motor vehicles on campus. However, bicycles are allowed and can be purchased from the campus store.

question: Can I bring my own mattress to the hostel?
answer: If logistics permit it, sure. Otherwise, you can buy one from the campus store.

question: When does room assignment happen?
answer: Document verification and room assignment happen on the same day. You will be assigned a hostel and a room after completing the admission formalities.

question: Is there any facility inside campus for parents of UG students to stay when they come for document verification?
answer: Unfortunately, no, parents are not allowed to stay in the official guesthouses until after you are officially admitted. There are affordable hotels nearby campus though, such as xx.

question: Can we choose hostel rooms or roommates in advance?
answer: No, hostel room allocation is random (through lottery system) and you will be assigned a room and a roommate on the day of reporting. Students typically cannot choose. However, room changes can be requested later, subject to availability and hostel rules.

question: Where do all the IISc students talk to each other?
answer: There are Whatsapp communities/groups and Discord servers with all the students. You have to be invited, though.

question: What if you don't have vaccine proof or dates?
Do the hostel rooms have fans or ACs?
answer: There are no ACs or fans in the hostel rooms, but Bangalore's weather isn't too hot either. Otherwise you can get your own table fan.

question: Can we bring/install our own AC or fan?
Do we incoming students get a freshers party?
answer: Yes, UG office will provide partial funding for a freshers party, the rest can come from freshers or seniors pooling money or, in some cases, sponsers.

question: What does freshmen orientation consist of?
answer: Institute academic resources.

question: How long does freshmen orientation last, overall and daily?
answer: Use your institute credentials.

question: What is the freshmen talent show?
answer: Sangam is the institue-wise freshmen talent show. There will be club performances there too.

question: What will the freshers party have?
answer: It highly varies year to year, but there will likely be a DJ, snacks, and the freshman talent show Sangam.

question: Is IISc a college, standalone institution, or university?
answer: University

question: What is the SR number in the onboarding forms?
answer: The Student Registration number is issued by IISc, and that will be provided to you at the time of document verification after in-person reporting.

answer: Yes, Saturday and Sunday are holidays. As for sample class timings, check out: (link)

question: Can we take a double major at IISc? Or a major and minor?
answer: You can do a major and minor, but doing a double major at IISc is neither administratively feasible nor recommended due to the depth of IISc courses. Regardless, it is highly recommended to make any lasting academic decisions as you start with your courses, to make more informed decisions.

question: What do I need to bring for document verification?
answer: Medical reports as proof, as well as the UG Annexure pdf they send you with the offer letter.

question: In general, how much academic freedom do we have?
answer: You have no restrictions on attending classes or courses as long as you complete core courses. You also have a wide selection of electives.

question: How many days of vacation do they give for Diwali? In general?
answer: For Diwali, one extra day-- making it just a long weekend. Apart from the summer and winter breaks, there are very few holidays.

question: Do we have a minimum attendance requirement?
answer: Yes, every semester, you have to have minimum 80% attendance, including tutorials per subject you take.

question: What will happen in medical document verification?
answer: They will go through your reports, give advice if anything stands out, and will tell you to get the rest of the vaccines if not already taken. They will give you a permanent certificatae if all vaccines are administered, or a temporary certificate that you submit in the UG office if all vaccines are not administered. Do not worry about the temporary certificate-- many people in IISc do it.

question: Is there a college newspaper?
